purpose: Promote mapped-sheet records into visible per-sheet and per-source-cell status overlays inside the standalone Havenwild Atlas Mapper.
sourceOfTruth: mapper project pieces for the active unsaved draft
terrain and asset source sheet stack cards

statusModel.tileGreenCheck: Exact source tile metadata exists in a saved mapped-sheet record or current correction draft.
statusModel.sheetGreenCheck: At least one mapped-sheet record exists and reports mapped source cells; this is not runtime publication.
statusModel.validated: A handoff/export or future validation record exists.

rules: Per-tile status is keyed by source sheet plus source_tile_x/source_tile_y/source_rect.
The renderer must still draw exact source rectangles and must not visually guess tile identity.
The status overlay is an authoring aid for mapping coverage and does not make a tile runtime-authoritative by itself.
next: Learn From Scene converts corrected drafts into learned mapping records.
Group boxing promotes modular terrain, water, shore, cliff, and structure groups from tile-level evidence.
